in_sanskrit.name: Lakshit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Aim, Goal, Target, Objective
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lakshit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who sets goals and works towards achieving them. The name Lakshit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'laksh' which means goal post. It is a name that inspires one to set clear objectives and work towards their achievement.
